traces.label: The whole mechanism, in three steps
traces.note: The model did not run pwd. It asked; the harness ran it and appended the answer; the model then read that answer and spoke.

steps.text: Same workspace as before: `/home/adrian/PhD/Adrian-Mag.github.io` — your Adrian-Mag.github.io git repo on the `main` branch, running on your laptop under WSL2.

traces.label: The loop, iterating
traces.note: Looking at a web page: the model cannot see one. It asks for a scroll, asks for a screenshot, then asks to read the resulting file — three round trips for what a person does with one glance.
